subject.title: fix(repair): close staged proof review gaps

question: Should the durable router, staged-proof, requeue, validation-isolation, and final-mutation hardening land together at the current exact head?
rationale: The implementation appears technically coherent, but it combines multiple privileged automation boundaries whose operational blast radius and rollout shape require maintainer ownership.

options.title: Review and land together
options.body: Accept the combined fail-closed rollout after the exact-head required checks pass and the privileged mutation invariants receive focused review.

options.title: Split privileged surfaces
options.body: Separate router durability, validation isolation, or final-mutation hardening into narrower PRs if the combined patch cannot be reviewed confidently.

options.title: Keep the draft paused
options.body: Leave the PR draft until its exact-head check failure and any remaining operational proof gaps are resolved.

recommendation.title: Review and land together
recommendation.body: Accept the combined fail-closed rollout after the exact-head required checks pass and the privileged mutation invariants receive focused review.
